rules.description: Registration of verifying authorities must be completed before the portal is made live to the public for scholarship applications 2017-18.
rules.condition: Before the portal is made live to the general public for making scholarship applications for 2017-18.
rules.outcome: Registration of verifying authorities is required.
rules.evidence_quote: It, inter-alia, includes registration of verifying authorities, creation of credentials (login/password) for verifying authorities, updation of metadata by the institutes (courses, fee etc.) on Portal.

rules.description: Creation of credentials (login/password) for verifying authorities must be completed before the portal is made live to the public for scholarship applications 2017-18.
rules.condition: Before the portal is made live to the general public for making scholarship applications for 2017-18.
rules.outcome: Creation of credentials (login/password) for verifying authorities is required.
rules.evidence_quote: It, inter-alia, includes registration of verifying authorities, creation of credentials (login/password) for verifying authorities, updation of metadata by the institutes (courses, fee etc.) on Portal.

rules.description: Institutes must update metadata (courses, fee etc.) on the portal before it is made live to the public for scholarship applications 2017-18.
rules.condition: Before the portal is made live to the general public for making scholarship applications for 2017-18.
rules.outcome: Updation of metadata by the institutes (courses, fee etc.) on the portal is required.
